Section 5 provides that the order is effective immediately and revokes Executive Order 10016 of November 10, 1948. The revocation is a one-time self-executing act, complete on the order's date, October 7, 1975, and the order's own words say it takes effect immediately; no later act is needed or recorded. The commencement sentence is likewise spent on that date. The surviving consequence, that Executive Order 10016 stays revoked, is a status rather than a continuing command.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 11884 of October 7, 1975 (40 FR 47469) prescribes the official coat of arms, seal, and flag of the Vice President (sections 1 to 4), declares that these designs shall represent the Vice President exclusively, and revokes Executive Order 10016 of November 10, 1948 (section 5). The held original (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11884.txt, an official Federal Register OCR text with irregular letter spacing and the attached flag specifications) has no deadline, expiry, condition or other own-terms end, and rests on the President's own authority, not a statute that could lapse. No held current-law record (U.S. Code note or eCFR text) names the order, so the current predicate rests on the held original read with the three bounded machine searches, each of which returned zero hits for this order: the U.S. Code search (every citation of the order by number in the text and notes of the titles read, edition current through 2026-10-09), the eCFR search (point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML) and the Federal Register disposition catalog search (6942 catalog records naming the order as amended, revoked, superseded or otherwise affected, plus operative sentences in saved order texts). The held later-events chain is empty and the 1989 OFR codification entry only locates the order. Absence of a located amendment or revocation is therefore the whole basis for the continuing finding; it is a bounded-search result, not an affirmative current-law source. The one command that was performed and spent is section 5's revocation of Executive Order 10016, effective on the order's signing.
